decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed first floor to existing bungalow, by reason of its position, height and excessive depth, would represent an obtrusive development which would result in enclosure and loss of outlook to the rear of the neighbouring property, resulting in an unacceptable loss of residential amenity, contrary to adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1 & H.3.4 and revised deposit UDP (January 2001) policies ENV-B.1.1 & H.6.4 and the Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).

Condition : 2 - 2/ The resultant two-storey detached house, due to its excessive depth, would form a bulky and incongruous feature on this highly visible corner location, detrimental to the appearance of the streetscene and contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1, H.3.4 and Revised Deposit Policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4. (January 2001) and the Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).
description: ERECTION OF FIRST FLOOR EXTENSION TO EXISTING BUNGALOW TO CREATE DETACHED TWO-STOREY SIX BEDROOM HOUSE INCORPORATING ADDITIONAL PARKING WITHIN FRONT GARDEN
